validation_checkpoint_selection: Highest validation average precision; ROC-AUC is the deterministic tie-breaker.

split.source: Existing deterministic Phase 3.1 training-only graph; its 4,611 held-out edges were split into validation and test.

negative_sampling.ratio: 1:1 negatives to positives for training, validation, and test.
negative_sampling.rule: Uniform job-skill pair sampling; every known positive edge from all splits is excluded.
negative_sampling.unobserved_pair_caveat: Unobserved pairs may be undiscovered true relationships and are treated as negatives for this benchmark.

phase3_2_reference_different_protocol.protocol: Existing Phase 3.2 single 20% per-job edge holdout; not directly identical to the GraphSAGE test subset.

limitations: Node features are trainable ID embeddings because the graph has no validated numeric or textual node-feature matrix; category and job-title metadata are not model inputs.
The model is transductive and uses the full node universe, including skills without a training edge; ranking candidates are restricted to training-visible skills for baseline comparability.
Sampled unobserved pairs are not guaranteed true negatives.
Phase 3.2 reference scores use a different single 20% edge holdout; same-test-split frequency and co-occurrence metrics are provided for direct ranking comparison.
